lessons.claim: A slow estimator silently pushes work toward single-seed results. The direct double-loop MSD took 1.0 s to integrate and 93 s to analyse a 300x200,001 run - 99% of the cost was analysis, which made a seed ensemble unaffordable and therefore made A2 (no number without an error bar) unaffordable. The FFT identity MSD(m)=S1(m)-2*S2(m) computes ALL lags faster than the direct method computed 148, and agrees to 9e-13. With the ensemble affordable, a single-run D of 0.98845 that looked 1.2% systematically low turned out to be 0.37 sigma from 1 across 8 seeds. Measured 2026-09-02.
